caption: Eleven presents, one bus ticket home. Is spreading December across the year the only way it works?

slides.title:
How I'm funding
December on
R23 800 p/m
South Africa
Living in Alberton
slides.body:
Female, 33
Single, no kids
Job: Stock controller at a distribution centre
Net salary: R23 800 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: 1 bed in Alberton, water and refuse
slides.body: I moved here for the taxi rank. I stayed for the landlord who fixes things.

slides.title: December travel fund
slides.includes: Bus tickets home to Mthatha for me and my cousin
slides.body: Tickets double after the 15th. I put this aside every month since July.

slides.title: Black tax
slides.includes: My mom's groceries and my brother's rent
slides.body: It goes up in December because everyone needs something at the same time.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Checkers and the corner shop for bread
slides.body: I shop for one and cook for three on Sundays.

slides.title: Gifts & festive groceries
slides.includes: Presents for eleven people, meat for the family braai
slides.body: I swear I buy nothing for myself. The list is just long.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Taxi fare, electricity, phone, funeral policy, clothing account, stokvel
slides.body: The stokvel pays out on the 5th of December. It's already spent on paper.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R23 800. December only works because I started putting money aside in July.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I set up a budget in Beyond Horizon with a December line and imported my statement actuals.

It showed the travel and gift money was already moving.

No bank login needed.
